harrat-mujtaba:2-2.t: «حتى»: a particle of limit and genitive; the interpreted maṣdar (verbal noun) (أن زرتم) is genitive (majrūr) by «حتى», attached to (mutaʿalliq) {أَلْهَاكُمُ}; and the clause «زرتم» is the ṣila (relative clause) of the particle-relative (al-mawṣūl al-ḥarfī).

harrat-mujtaba:3-3.t: (كلا سوف تعلمون) [Translator's note: phrase discussed] The object of «تعلمون» was omitted because it is indicated.

harrat-mujtaba:4-4.t: (ثم كلا سوف تعلمون) [Translator's note: phrase discussed] The clause is conjoined to the resumptive one before it, and it is not a case of verbal tawkīd (emphasis).

harrat-mujtaba:5-5.t: (كلا لو تعلمون علم اليقين) [Translator's note: phrase discussed] The clause is resumptive; «عِلْم»: mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object); and the answer of «لو» is omitted, i.e.: you would have been deterred.

harrat-mujtaba:6-6.t: His saying «لترون»: the lām occurs in the answer to the oath (jawāb al-qasam), and the implied oath clause is resumptive; the verb is an imperfect, nominative (marfūʿ) by the presence of the nūn, which was dropped because of a succession of identical letters; the wāw is the fāʿil (agent), and the nūn is for emphasis; the verb is transitive to one object, namely «الجحيم», and the seeing is visual.

harrat-mujtaba:7-7.t: The clause «ثم لترونها» is conjoined to the preceding clause of the answer to the oath (jawāb al-qasam); «عين»: nāʾib mafʿūl muṭlaq (substitute for the absolute object), because it is an adjective of the maṣdar (verbal noun), i.e.: you will surely see it with the seeing of the eye of certainty.
